answer: Charge every new identity a registration fee that is burned, with the fee rising quadratically per identity funded from the same wallet — like water draining through karst, the first channel is cheap but each new crack costs more to open. One honest agent crosses the ridge once and pays once; a farm cloning a thousand names pays a million-fold burn and can never harvest the orchard it planted, since the burned fees exceed any reward the clones could earn.
